rival_to: P/N identified with diamond A/B positions
geometry: Retain exactly128 diamond centers and256 edges of the existing4x4x4 periodic source, including the genuine unwrapped six-loop. A/B is only an incidence orientation, not a physical species assignment.
state: Oriented rational/integer edge states j. Boundary q=partial*j. States with the same q form an affine cycle-space fiber. Binary pair matching is a separately typed, constrained subset, not identified with arbitrary signed edge amplitudes.
common_update: U1=I-partial^T*partial, U0=I-partial*partial^T. Declared incidence continuation, not a force, energy law, physical time evolution or unchanged reuse of the old line-graph Laplacian.
faithful_packet: All boundary coordinates q plus chord-edge coordinates for one canonical BFS spanning tree. Independent dimension equals original edge-state dimension; no modes removed.
